segments.contextAfter:
```swift
Chart {
    AreaPlot(
        portfolioElements,
        x: .value("Date", \.date),
        y: .value("Asset value", \.assetValue),
        series: .value("Asset", \.asset),
        stacking: .standard
    )
    .foregroundStyle(by: .value("Asset", \.asset))
}
```
